basic_profile.bio: A Scottish gamer and lifelong Watford FC supporter living in Aberdeen. I've been on Reddit since the early days, sharing my passion for gaming, particularly Diabotical, and indulging in nostalgia with That 70s Show. By day, I work in IT as a network administrator, ensuring smooth operations for a mid-sized tech company. In my free time, I enjoy exploring the beautiful landscapes of Scotland and catching up on the latest football matches. I’m married with two kids, and we enjoy cozy family nights watching sitcoms. I’m most active on Reddit during the evenings and weekends.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: With a background in computer science, I have spent over 20 years in the IT industry, specializing in network infrastructure and cybersecurity. My knowledge has been honed through both formal education and years of hands-on experience. Additionally, my love for gaming has kept me abreast of the latest trends and technologies in the gaming world.
